summary: Your scripts and AI assistant can now do more, while a person still saves every change.

new.title: API and MCP reference in Settings
new.text: Find it under Settings > API and MCP reference, shown for your own role, with a plain description of each route.

new.title: More AI assistant tools
new.text: The assistant can now decide and end access requests, and read conformance, role permissions, commit history, permissions health and the config backup list.

new.title: Scripts and services can use PIM Manager
new.text: SuperAdmins can allow named applications to read, prepare changes and run jobs. It is off by default, and a person still saves every change.
